review_candidates.title: Director of Sales, Middle East
review_candidates.description: Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth. Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one. Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles. As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains. We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world. Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands. About The Role The Director of Sales, Middle East will be responsible for leading our regional sales organization, driving Planet’s Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy, and accelerating revenue growth across national security, defense, and government sectors. In this highly strategic role, you will lead high-performing teams, build executive relationships across defense ministries and key contractors, and position Planet's Earth observation platform as an essential capability for mission-critical operations. Ideal candidates are ambitious commercial leaders with deep defense domain expertise, exceptional strategic vision, and a passion for driving transformational business outcomes. The ideal candidate is an accomplished sales leader with deep defense domain expertise and a track record of managing high-performing teams in the region. You will bring an established executive network across Defense Ministries, Intelligence Agencies, and key Prime Contractors/System Integrators. Combining strategic commercial acumen with an understanding of national security priorities, you will position Planet as a trusted capability provider for mission-critical operations. This is a full-time, remote position based in the United Arab Emirates. If located near an office, you are expected to work from that office 3 days per week Impact You’ll Own Drive Strategic Revenue Growth: Own and execute a result-oriented Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy to build, negotiate, and close high-value, complex deals across sovereign defense and government sectors, consistently hitting or exceeding regional quota targets. Forecast Governance & Predictability: Maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene (Salesforce.com) and deliver accurate, data-driven revenue forecasts to executive leadership through disciplined deal inspection and pipeline management. Capture Strategy & Value Messaging: Engineer tailored capture strategies and high-impact executive narratives that align with agency-level priorities, resonate with key decision-makers, and win competitive procurements. Manage, Coach & Empower: Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing sales team, establishing a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous professional development. Methodology Alignment: Train and inspect direct reports on core sales methodologies and capture frameworks (e.g., MEDDPICC, Shipley), coaching them on deal qualification, stakeholder mapping, and win strategies. Talent Bench & Scaling: Proactively recruit, onboard, and retain elite commercial and defense-domain talent to build a solid talent bench as the regional footprint expands. Cross-Functional Matrix Alignment: Orchestrate seamless collaboration across internal matrix teams—including Government Affairs, Product, Engineering, and Field Marketing—to align corporate capabilities with regional market opportunities. Technical & Post-Sales Win Alignment: Partner closely with Pre-Sales/Solutions Engineering to secure technical wins, and collaborate with Post-Sales teams to ensure flawless customer onboarding, retention, and long-term expansion. Deal Cadence & Executive Escalation: Communicate deal velocity transparently across internal business units, mobilizing executive sponsorship and cross-functional support when needed to de-risk complex pursuits. What You Bring 8+ years of experience with a track record of driving revenue growth, building high-performing teams, and consistently exceeding multi-million-dollar individual & team quotas. 6+ years of progressive leadership and management experience. Ability to recruit, mentor, and retain top-tier talent, instilling a high accountability culture and coaching direct reports through complex, multi-year deal cycles. Deep experience establishing pipeline discipline, accurate revenue forecasting, and thorough deal inspection using Salesforce.com and modern sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDPICC). Extensive background navigating complex government and defense procurement frameworks across the Middle East, with a primary focus on key markets including the UAE, KSA, Oman, and Bahrain. An established, C-level network across Ministries of Defense, Intelligence Agencies, and Tier-1 Prime Contractors / System Integrators in the MENA region. Deep understanding of how commercial technology and advanced data feeds support sovereign defense, intelligence, and national security missions. Success collaborating across internal matrixed teams (Government Affairs, Product, Engineering, Legal) to align corporate capabilities with regional opportunities. A strategic, self-directed leader with sound commercial judgment, adept at leading teams through dynamic, high-growth, or startup-like market environments. What Makes You Stand Out 5+ years of progressive sales leadership and enterprise business development experience within the defense, national security, or government technology sectors, with a track record of building high-performing teams and consistently exceeding revenue targets. Deep operational understanding of defense domain priorities, sovereign procurement frameworks, and agency decision-making processes across the UK and EMEA regions. Experience managing complex, multi-year deal cycles, with the ability to lead sales teams through disciplined capture frameworks, pipeline governance, and accurate revenue forecasting. Fluency in both English and Arabic is a solid plus, enabling the candidate to articulate complex strategic value propositions effectively to senior government ministers, agency leaders, and internal executives. Application Deadline Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting may be removed earlier than projected if a suitable pool of applications has been received. For this reason, we recommend applying as soon as you are able to. Benefits While Working At Planet These offerings are dependent on employment type and geographical location, based upon applicable law or company policy. Paid time off including vacation, holidays and company-wide days off Employee Wellness Program Home Office Reimbursement Monthly Phone and Internet Reimbursement Tuition Reimbursement and access to LinkedIn Learning Equity Volunteering Paid Time Off This role is also eligible to receive commission. San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Why We Care So Much About Belonging. We’re dedicated to helping the whole Planet, and to do that we must strive to represent all of it within each of our offices and on all of our teams. That’s why Planet is guided by an ultimate north star of Belonging—dreaming big as we approach our ongoing work. If this job intrigues you, but you’re thinking you might not have all the qualifications, please... do apply! At Planet, we are looking for well-rounded people from around the world who can contribute to more ways than just what is listed in this job description. We don’t just fill positions, we aspire to fulfill people’s careers, most excited about folks who are motivated by our underlying humanitarian efforts. We are a few orbits around the sun before we get to where we want to be, so we hope you’re excited to come along for the ride. EEO Statement Planet is committed to building a community where everyone belongs and we invite people from all backgrounds to apply. Planet is an equal opportunity employer, and committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Know Your Rights. Accommodations Planet is an inclusive community and we know that everyone has their own needs. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the hiring process, please reach out to accommodations@planet.com or contact your recruiter with your request. Your message will be confidential and we will be happy to assist you. Privacy Policy : By clicking "Apply Now" at the top of this job posting, I acknowledge that I have read the Planet Data Privacy Notice for California Staff Members and Applicants, and hereby consent to the collection, processing, use, and storage of my personal information as described therein. Privacy Policy (European Applicants): By clicking "Apply Now" at the top of this job posting, I acknowledge that I have read the Candidate Privacy Notice GDPR Planet Labs Europe, and hereby consent to the collection, processing, use, and storage of my personal information as described therein. AI in Our Interviewing Process : Planet is committed to providing an exceptional interview experience for all candidates. We currently use Metaview to better focus on candidates and less on trying to capture notes. As such, with the candidate's consent, select interviews may be recorded and include a "Planet AI Notetaker" for transcription and summarization purposes. Should an interview involve use of AI interview technologies, the candidate will receive notification and have the ability to opt out both in advance and/or real-time. Opting out will not affect one's candidacy. Candidate AI Policy : Planet embraces Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools, and we encourage its responsible use. We understand that candidates may use various resources, including AI tools, to prepare for interviews and assessments. However, during any live interview stage or when actively completing assessments for this position, the use of AI tools—e.g. Large Language Models (LLMs), deep fake technology, etc.—is strictly prohibited unless explicitly prompted by an interviewer or assessment instructions . If you are unsure about acceptable use, please contact your recruiter for clarification. If an AI tool or similar technology is desired as an accommodation, please contact accommodations@planet.com with your request for assistance. Your message will be confidential, and we will be happy to assist you. Violation of this policy may result in disqualification of your application.

review_candidates.title: Channel Marketing Manager, LATAM
review_candidates.description: Reporting to the Managing Director, Head of Latin America, the Channel Marketing Manager will translate established business and marketing priorities into integrated campaigns, advertising, content, digital experiences, sales enablement and partner initiatives. The role will collaborate with Distribution, Product Management, Digital, Marketing Operations, Compliance and external partners to deliver coordinated, effective and locally relevant marketing programs across Latin America.   E ssential Duties and Responsibilities: Includes the following, other duties may be assigned as needed: Execute integrated marketing initiatives that support business priorities, distribution objectives and focus products across Latin America. Support select U.S. Offshore marketing initiatives as directed and where aligned with broader business priorities. Develop high-quality campaigns and content supporting priority investment strategies, market opportunities and Distribution objectives. Partner with digital and creative agencies to develop campaign concepts, advertising copy and creative assets for Latin American audiences. Manage the end-to-end creative development process, including briefs, stakeholder feedback, revisions, Compliance review and final production. Adapt and leverage existing U.S., European and global campaigns and content for Latin American audiences, ensuring regional relevance and appropriate localization. Develop and coordinate marketing programs across paid media, email, websites, third-party platforms, content distribution and sales enablement channels. Work with publishers, media partners and distribution platforms to promote VanEck research, investment commentary, videos and product content. Partner with the LATAM Marketing Operations & Content Strategist to maintain and optimize VanEck’s Latin America websites and support select updates to U.S. Offshore digital properties as needed. Collaborate on SEO and AEO initiatives to improve organic visibility, content discoverability and engagement across VanEck’s Latin America digital properties. Review Spanish-language marketing materials and translations to ensure they are accurate, natural and appropriate for Latin American audiences. Coordinate Portuguese-language adaptations as needed. Partner with the Managing Director, Head of Latin America and Distribution teams to understand sales needs, client opportunities and upcoming business priorities. Develop and maintain sales enablement materials, including presentations, product messaging, emails, campaign materials and other resources. Support conferences, roadshows, due diligence meetings, webinars, client events and educational programs, including related marketing materials and communications. Develop and coordinate marketing support for product launches, cross-listings and other strategic regional initiatives. Partner with Product Management to ensure investment strategies and focus products are positioned accurately, consistently and effectively. Collaborate with Compliance throughout the review and approval process for marketing materials. Track and analyze campaign, websites, advertising and content performance, using results to identify optimization opportunities and inform future initiatives. Coordinate with internal Creative, Digital, Marketing Operations, Events, Data and other Marketing teams to ensure the timely execution of regional priorities. Manage relationships and workflows with agencies, publishers, translators, consultants and other external partners as needed. Help develop scalable processes that improve the efficiency, consistency and quality of marketing execution across Latin America.   Qualifications   Strong understanding of integrated and digital marketing, including paid media, email, websites, content distribution and third-party platforms. Experience working with creative or digital agencies to develop and execute advertising and marketing campaigns. Superior written and interpersonal communication skills, with strong attention to detail and quality assurance. Excellent project management and proven delivery skills. Ability to analyze marketing performance and KPIs and use results to optimize campaigns and marketing programs. Demonstrated success integrating marketing initiatives across channels in support of common business goals and objectives. Ability to work in a deadline-driven environment with changing priorities; self-sufficient, proactive and well-organized. Excellent Spanish-language writing and editing skills, including the ability to review and adapt marketing content for Latin American audiences. Experience collaborating effectively with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams across Latin America, the U.S. and Europe, including in a distributed working environment. Familiarity with SEO, AEO and evolving digital content discovery practices preferred. Experience with CMS platforms and digital analytics and project management tools preferred. Experience working with ETFs, asset management or financial services products preferred; familiarity with investment products and financial markets is a plus. Experience supporting Latin American audiences preferred; experience supporting U.S. Offshore audiences is a plus. Strong understanding of regional language, cultural and market nuances across Latin America preferred. Ability to travel periodically within Latin America and to the U.S. to support client events, conferences and other business initiatives as needed.   Education and/or Experience                                             5-7 years of relevant marketing experience. Bachelor's degree preferably in marketing, business, communications, finance or economics. Professional fluency in English and Spanish required. Experience supporting Latin American and/or US Offshore audiences preferred. Background in bilingual content localization and translation coordination preferred. Portuguese language skills or experience supporting the Brazilian market are a plus.   Competencies                                               To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies: Professional demeanor Capacity for learning new procedures/ideas Motivation Enthusiasm   VanEck is committed to treating all applicants and employees fairly and to providing equal opportunity in compliance with applicable federal, state and local laws. VanEck does not and will not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, religion, ancestry, color, gender, gender identity, pregnancy, age, physical or mental disability, national origin, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status, covered-veteran or military status, genetic information, and/or any other factor protected by law. Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights notice from the Department of Labor.

Proficiency with Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including maintaining trackers and analyzing data. Comfortable using procurement, ERP, accounting, contract management, or purchase order systems.
